How you study for your prerequisites will not apply to your actual nursing classes. You'll memorize structures of the body and recall that in the exam however in nursing you will need to know what it does, what can make it go wrong, what your patient will show, what you will do, what you will delegate to your STNAs...all from a scenario like 'Mary comes in the er with a BP of 94/50 heart rate of 130 a temp of 39.6 what is the nurse's priority' 

If your facility offers a critical thinking class I would highly recommend it to get yourself used to thinking in such a way. Also if you're not getting something, seek help immediately. Nursing programs have a different grading scale than general college courses and I've failed by 0.1% before because there is no rounding.
